extensions.name: Adjustments Pro
extensions.description: Photoshop's core adjustments: Levels, Curves, Exposure, Vibrance, Hue/Saturation, Color Balance, Black & White, Photo Filter, Gradient Map, Shadows/Highlights, Equalize, plus Auto Tone, Auto Contrast and Auto Color.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Background Remover
extensions.description: Cut subjects out of their background in a dedicated tab: AI subject detection (U²-Net), a magic wand, erase/restore brushes and edge clean-up. Also adds Layer ▸ Remove Background and Select ▸ Subject.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Basic Filters
extensions.description: Gaussian & Box Blur, Unsharp Mask, Sharpen, Add Noise, Mosaic, plus Brightness/Contrast, Posterize and Threshold adjustments.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Batch Converter
extensions.description: Convert and resize images in batches in its own tab: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, GIF, TIFF and ICO from almost anything - including PSD, HEIC and camera RAW (Canon, Nikon, Sony, Fuji…). Animated GIF/WebP stay animated. Also lets File ▸ Open read HEIC, AVIF and RAW, and Save As write GIF, AVIF and ICO.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Creative Filters
extensions.description: Photoshop's creative filter menu: Motion & Radial Blur, Twirl, Pinch, Spherize, Ripple, Wave, Polar Coordinates, Median, Dust & Scratches, Color Halftone, Crystallize, Clouds, Vignette, Emboss, Find Edges, Oil Paint, Solarize, Diffuse, High Pass, Minimum/Maximum and Offset.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: GIF Optimiser
extensions.description: Shrink a GIF in its own tab: a Compression slider, one-click Discord Emoji / Sticker presets and 1-500 MiB target sizes, a before/after preview, and optional resizing for social posts.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Image Optimiser
extensions.description: Shrink a still image in its own tab: Compression slider, Discord Emoji / Sticker presets, 1-500 MiB targets and social-media sizes. Works on files or straight from the picture open in Lumen.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Layer Effects
extensions.description: Photoshop-style layer styles — Drop Shadow, Outer Glow, Inner Shadow, Inner Glow, Stroke, Color Overlay, Gradient Overlay and Bevel & Emboss — each created on its own layer with a live preview (Layer ▸ Layer Style).
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Overlay Studio
extensions.description: Place one image over another in its own tab - animated GIFs and WebPs keep moving. Drag or snap the forefront to 9 positions, scale it, fade it, and save as PNG, GIF, WebP or AVIF, or open the result in Lumen. Either image can come straight from Lumen.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Video to GIF
extensions.description: Turn a clip from any common video (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI…) into a GIF or animated WebP in its own tab: pick start, length, frame rate and width, see the real file size before saving, or open the frames as layers in Lumen.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Video to Image
extensions.description: Scrub through any video frame by frame in its own tab (zoom the slider in for precise picking), then save the exact frame, copy it, open it in Lumen or add it as a layer. Can also export a whole run of frames as PNGs or layers.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: Web Images Extractor
extensions.description: A built-in web browser in its own tab. Browse any page, collect every image it shows (lazy-loaded ones too), then add them to your Lumen project as layers, open them as documents or save them.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: WebP Flipbook
extensions.description: Turn animated WebPs and flipbook / sprite-sheet images into animated GIFs in their own tab, with automatic grid detection, a grid overlay, an animation preview, transparency kept, PNG frame export, and frames-as-layers in Lumen.
extensions.author: Lumen

extensions.name: WebP to GIF
extensions.description: Batch-convert WebP files (animated or still) to GIF in their own tab, with Quality, Frames and Width controls, target-size presets, a live preview of each result, and Open in Lumen (frames as layers).
extensions.author: Lumen
